slides.subtitle: Three shifts that actually move pipeline now.

slides.body: Relationships compound. Sequences don't. Build a referral motion before you scale another SDR seat. Personally, the most reliable pipeline I've seen comes from 3-4 people who actively introduce.
Reference a hiring change, a recent post, a funding round. Generic openers get deleted on sight. The win is showing you noticed something real before you reached out.
LinkedIn touch, then email, then a voice note. Same message stacked across channels reads as spam. Different message per channel reads as a person who actually wants to talk.

slides.subtitle: We do this for RevOps teams every week.
